rationale: Issue #95 requires meaningful series/context opportunities rather than idle time or drain batch count. Frozen Python fixtures remain unchanged.
runtime: Successful Dream completion counts a fully consumed session with persisted fresh evidence once. Current claims in its persisted series, language and story context permit a 0.02 strength reduction down to 0.20 within residual existing caps.
protections: Active rules and explicit user authority or confirmation
Records created or modified since session start
Unknown, qualified, invalid or incompatible claims
invariants: No passive confidence, text, status or deletion writes
No decay for idle, skipped, empty, failed or partial batches
Opportunity ledger, exact score events, phase audit and run completion commit atomically
Capped opportunities cannot replay on restart
limitations: Session context does not persist request-local research mode
No catch-up opportunity for failed sessions
